findings.source: gpu-r2-pointer-stream.py actual/scheduled times; validate.py:pointer_input; gpu-r2-native.py producer subprocess
findings.finding: Consumer validates scheduled deadlines, but does not validate sent_ns or finished_ns. A delayed/catch-up producer can deliver the whole ordered path while failing the intended fixed temporal workload and still pass. 35-second process timeout is insufficient 120 Hz schedule conformance.
findings.required: Declare finite sent-deadline lateness and active duration tolerances before execution; validate monotonic actual send times, actual duration and lateness, retain distribution. Reject first timing invalidity without retry. Cross-check stream interval with active CPU interval. No producer rehearsal required.

findings.source: gpu-r2-native.py GPU epoch collection and gpu_sample calls
findings.finding: Expected GPU epoch is taken from the sample set itself. All GPU samples may coherently name an epoch different from the live-device drain/input receipt, and pass current validation.
findings.required: Cross-check the singleton GPU epoch against shutdown_receipt.device_epoch and recorded input epoch/final state; validate input receipt PID equals launched PID. Pass independently observed epoch into gpu_sample.
